pwa.installDescription: One tap to add Blast to your home screen.
pwa.getAppSubtitle: Install it on your phone for a faster, fullscreen experience.
pwa.iosStep1: Open this page in Safari, then tap the Share button (the square with an up arrow).
pwa.iosStep2: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen.
pwa.iosStep3: Tap Add in the top-right corner. The Blast icon will appear on your home screen.
pwa.iosTip: Tip: If you don't see the option, scroll the share sheet up to reveal more actions.
pwa.androidStep1: Open this page in Chrome, then tap the ⋮ menu in the top-right corner.
pwa.androidStep2: Tap Install app (or Add to Home screen).
pwa.androidStep3: Confirm by tapping Install. The Blast icon will appear on your home screen.
pwa.androidTip: Tip: If a banner appears, just tap Install — no menu needed.
